scripts.setup: bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run typecheck && cargo build --workspace --release --locked
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test:ts && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo test --workspace --locked && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings
scripts.simulate:example: bun run compile:example && cargo run -q -p spellwire-cli --locked -- simulate examples/stateful.spellwire.bin key-down:Q key-up:Q key-down:Q key-up:Q key-down:Q key-up:Q
scripts.pack:dry-run: npm pack --dry-run --workspace spellwire && npm pack --dry-run --workspace create-spellwire
